design_rationale:
TASK 1 WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — financial_assistance, scenario env_0028_clinical_laboratory_company.

[Step 0 — draw, scope snapshot, thesis]
Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1, printed): {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 6]}; every problem of the tree takes 6 factors.
Occupied by task 0: assistance_ext_award_discount (apply_award_discount_6c746b08) and assistance_ext_renewal_tier (submit_renewal_application_d691b1b8) — the award stage. Claimed here, all disjoint from task 0: assistance_ext_countable_percent (reassess_assistance_percent_a70c4477, event assistance_tier_redetermined, state_due), assistance_ext_document_period (request_assistance_documents_a6db5abf, event assistance_documents_requested, state_due), assistance_ext_document_extension (request_document_extension_ca0bff0a, owner=user, event assistance_documents_extended, on_request). This is the last task: the five extended policies are now each claimed exactly once.
Thesis: the customer only asks for more time to send his documents. Surface goal -> extension days (root, his own request) -> prerequisite 1 (state form): the extended due date is not fixed until the case carries a documents-requested date and a due date -> the documents request's response period (6 factors) -> prerequisite 2 (action form): that period is fixed only after the case's percent is reassessed on countable income -> the countable percent (6 factors). Terminal state: the case carries percent 133.1 with the Full Discount tier, documents requested 2026-10-06, pending documents, due date 2027-01-14 after one extension. Depth: a 3-problem chain, both edges value_input. Breadth: coverage history (ended employer plan, pending Medicaid), invoice ledger (payment methods, channels, a returned ACH payment), order test charges, payment plan, visits and their fees, eight document lines on the case.
Why a good test: nothing the customer says mentions a request, a percent or Medicaid. The agent must notice that an extension cannot be counted without a due date, that the request is owed but its period turns on the Medicaid screening line, that the recorded percent is the intake figure and must first be reassessed on countable income — and then price three calculations, each with six rules read from different records.
Scope note on the base event model: these three events declare no cross-category trigger; every tool writes only assistance_cases.

[Base-invariant card]
Write 1 (assistance_tier_redetermined) — governing base policy assistance_tier_determination (no structured gate). Inherited: household definition, spouse income counted, the band boundaries (income tier applies above fpl_min_pct and at most fpl_max_pct), no asset test, the guideline amounts. Overwritten (declared): the percent formula sentence (countable income replaces annual income) and the 'redetermined to the documented tier before the decision' sentence (reassessment before any request, recorded even when the tier stays).
Write 2 (assistance_documents_requested) — governing base policy assistance_evt_documentation; its only gate (documents_overdue) applies to denials, so the write is policy_scope. Overwritten (declared): the due-date sentence (documents_due_days -> the response days) and the document-period counting sentence (the period now runs to the due date the case records). Inherited: which document types count, the zero-income attestation, the one-most-recent-tax-year rule, Medicaid screening for an uninsured applicant at or below the tier's line, the extension maximum.
Write 3 (assistance_documents_extended) — same governing policy, policy_scope; overwritten (declared): 'extended by document_extension_days, at most max_document_extensions times' replaced by the counted extension days with the same maximum. extension_count 0 at the opening, so the single extension the tier allows is available. No time gate on any of the three writes.

[Business-object card]
Target object of all three writes: case 270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2 (customer 9c691564-8399-4c99-98ca-692bb6a09e5a), the only case. Rows entering the countable percent: payments on invoices 51263318 (five payments and the ACH reversal) and 51288940 (one payment) within the 4-month window; plan installments of plan de1208fd-a6cf-4b68-94b3-fc07cfe902d6 within the window; visit fees of the mobile visit 6ade2bf2-7629-4e26-9b67-f350410cd934; test charges of four orders; the case's unemployment statements. Excluded: the 2026-04-14 payment and the 2026-05-20 installment (outside the window), the health savings card payment (payment-kind rule), the no-show fee of 1fb084ff-6682-4bf0-9ae0-f64d98490d9d (penalty), the returned-payment fee (not a payment).

[Factor card — countable percent (133.1; all-baseline 138.1)]
deduction_window (method): coverage ended < 12 months ago -> months since + 1 / no coverage ever -> 18 / else 12. Tier: 4 months. Baseline 12 -> 132.8. Near-miss: the 2026-04-14 payment and 2026-05-20 installment sit just outside.
recognition_rate (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty orders): no active coverage AND >= 6 test charges in 12 months -> 100 / no active coverage AND fewer -> 75 / else 50. Tier 100 (11 charges). Baseline 50 -> 134.3. Near-miss: the Medicaid plan on file is only pending verification, not active.
payment_kinds (method): health savings card used -> exclude it and transfers / transfers only -> exclude transfers / else all less returned. Tier 1 (180.00 card). Baseline -> 132.5.
plan_installments (parameter, cross-difficulty plans): active plan, none missed in 6 months -> installments in window / past due or defaulted -> 50 percent of them / else 0. Tier 1 (200.00). Baseline -> 133.7.
collection_fees (parameter, cross-difficulty visits): homebound -> all fees / trip fee paid -> trip, additional-patient, weekend fees / else 0. Tier 2 (110.00; the 60.00 no-show fee excluded). Baseline -> 133.4.
benefit_disregard (parameter): unemployment statement dated <= 60 days before the application -> 1000.00 / Social Security letter only -> 500.00 / else 0. Tier 1. Baseline -> 136.2. Near-miss: a Social Security letter is also on file but the first tier takes precedence by its words.

[Factor card — document period (62 days; all-baseline 30)]
agency_allowance (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty coverage): uninsured AND percent <= screening line -> 15 / uninsured AND no line or above -> 5 / else 0. Tier 15 after the reassessment (133.1 <= 138). Baseline -> 45. Before the reassessment write the same ladder gives 5 (139.7 > 138).
tax_return_allowance (parameter): no return -> 12 / latest return's tax year ended > 12 whole months before the application -> 10 / else 0. Tier 10 (2024 return, 20 months). Baseline -> 50. Near-miss: a tax return IS on file, but for the wrong year.
household_earner_allowance (parameter): 5+ members with stubs and benefit documents -> 10 / 3-4 members with both -> 7 / else 0. Tier 7. Baseline -> 55.
file_credit (parameter): >= 6 documents -> 3 / 3-5 -> 1 / else 0. Tier 3 (8 lines; this is the history-heavy read, 8 own rows). Baseline -> 63.
response_count_convention (method): mail application -> the days counted so far run as business days from the request date / phone application without portal activity -> calendar days from the next business day after the request date (Monday when issued on a Friday) / else calendar days from the request date. Tier: phone application, no portal payment, mail and phone payments; issued Tuesday -> counted from Wednesday, 59 -> 60. Baseline -> 59.
weekend_move (parameter): Saturday -> +2 / Sunday -> +1 / else 0. Tier Saturday (2026-10-06 + 60 = 2026-12-05). Baseline -> 60.

[Factor card — extension (38 days; all-baseline 15)]
stay_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty visits): bedside collection within 60 days -> 7 / mobile in-home only -> 4 / else 0. Tier 7 (2026-09-10). Baseline -> 29. Near-miss: a mobile collection on 2026-09-21 also qualifies for the lower tier, excluded by the ladder's words.
time_left_credit (parameter): > 40 days to the due date -> 5 / 21-40 -> 2 / else 0. Tier 5 (62 days, a value set by the documents-request write). Baseline -> 45.
household_letter_allowance (parameter): Social Security letter -> 3 / zero-income attestation only -> 2 / else 0. Tier 3. Baseline -> 35.
coverage_loss_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage): coverage ended <= 120 days ago -> 3 / <= 365 -> 1 / else 0. Tier 3 (98 days). Baseline -> 35.
pending_coverage_allowance (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage): Medicaid pending -> 5 / other pending -> 2 / else 0. Tier 5. Baseline -> 31.
counting_convention (method): mail application -> business days + 3 / phone application without portal activity -> business days / else calendar days. Tier business days (28 business days from Monday 2026-12-07 = 38 calendar). Baseline 28.
Task floors: multi-source = recognition_rate, agency_allowance; cross-difficulty = deduction_window, recognition_rate, plan_installments, collection_fees, agency_allowance, stay_allowance, coverage_loss_allowance, pending_coverage_allowance; cross VALUE reads in all three computations.

[Problem-tree card]
Root assistance_ext_document_extension (owner=user). Edge A: extension <- documents request, value_input, gate binding days_left, form state, sentence 'The extended due date is not fixed until the case carries a documents-requested date and a documents due date.' (negated direction — the way a documents desk states a release that waits on something standing; it rewrites exactly into 'is fixed only after the case carries ...'). Four-point test: ordering connective 'not ... until'; record-visible state (two case fields); no tool, id or code token; scope exactly the condition. Exactly one write of this difficulty sets documents_requested_date: the documents request. Derivation: sentence + case record (both fields empty) + the document-period rule ('is set pending_documents with a documents due date ...') -> issue the request first.
Edge B: documents request <- reassessment, value_input, gate binding agency_days, form action, sentence 'The response period of a documents request is fixed only after the case's percent of the poverty guideline has been reassessed on the household's countable income.' (affirmative). fallback_reason: the reassessment rewrites the same percent and tier fields the intake wrote; no record marks a percent as already reassessed, so no state can stand for it. Four-point test: 'only after'; a plainly named business action; no code token; scope 'the case's percent'. Derivation: sentence + countable-percent rule ('A submitted application that carries no documents-requested date has its percent ... reassessed') -> reassess first.
Unmet at frozen_time: case documents_requested_date and documents_due_date empty, status submitted; recorded percent 139.7 = intake figure while the countable percent is 133.1.
Topological order: reassessment (step 15) -> request (step 17) -> extension (step 19); a chain, no parallel writes.
Deletion sensitivity (actual runs): without the reassessment the request reads 139.7 and gives 50 days instead of 62; without the documents request the extension has no due date (computation raises; the case never gets requested and due dates).
No-hint proof: user_scenario asks only for more time; it names no request, percent, Medicaid screening or deduction. Tools block nothing (single ctx.update calls; the extension tool falls back to today's date when no due date exists).

[Persona design]
Calvin Yarborough, laid off in June, recovering from knee surgery, slow and apologetic; opens with the one request; identity (4045559024, 1972-11-03, 30344) only when asked; household and income as stated at intake, insurance history (plan ended June 30, Medicaid applied October 1) and his habits (no portal, pays by phone or mail) only when asked; passive go-ahead when told something must be updated or sent first; runs the extension request himself with the reference number and days the agent gives; closes on the new due date. He volunteers nothing only gold creates and asks for nothing else.

[Seed rows — why each exists]
customers; coverages (ended employer plan: window, recognition, coverage-loss; pending Medicaid: pending allowance and why the household is uninsured); case K (submitted, intake percent, no request); 8 document lines (disregard, tax allowance, earner allowance, file credit, letter allowance); orders + 11 test charges (recognition rate; parents of invoices and visits); invoices + ledger (payments by kind and channel, the ACH reversal and fee); plan + ledger (installments in window); visits + fee lines (stay allowance, fees counted, the excluded no-show fee). Removing any of these rows changes one of the three values as recorded in the factor card. Claim lines (6) back the two insured invoices: the 2025 pathology deductible and the 2026 esoteric PR-204 denial transferred to the patient, both final and unappealed on the plan that ended 2026-06-30; they are read to establish that the payments counted paid settled bills.
Automatic clauses: the submitted application placed its open eligible invoices on assistance-review hold on 2026-09-28 (51263318, 51290127) within the 60-day limit; the pending Medicaid coverage was added 2026-10-02, two business days ago, inside the 3-business-day verification limit; no document deadline exists yet, so no denial for missing documents can fall due.

[Standard solution]
Locate (phone) -> verify (phone + DOB) -> read case, case documents, coverages, invoices, invoice ledger, orders, test charges, plan, plan ledger, visits, visit fees -> reassess_assistance_percent_a70c4477(270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2, 133.1, 'Financial Assistance Full Discount') -> request_assistance_documents_a6db5abf(270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2, 62) -> hand over request_document_extension_ca0bff0a, which the customer calls with (270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2, 38).

[Verification run]
check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 1: all OK (20 actions, deterministic, closure equals initial_state; 18 factors, 8 cross-difficulty, 13 own-history rows touched). Recompute: percent 133.1 (baselines 132.8, 134.3, 132.5, 133.7, 133.4, 136.2; all 138.1); response days 62 (baselines 45, 50, 55, 63, 59, 60; all 30; without the reassessment: 50); extension days 38 (baselines 29, 45, 35, 35, 31, 28; all 15). Runnable entry point: skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py <diff> --task 1.

[Revisions]
1) Symptom: zeroing the history aggregates left the response days at 62; root cause: the no-return allowance (14) exactly offset the earner allowance and the file credit and the weekend move landed on the same Monday; change: no-return days set to 12 (a household with no return at all needs a little more time than one with a stale return, never less); re-run: zeroed history gives 58, COMPUTE OK.
2) Symptom: claim lines were seeded although no computation of this task reads them; change: removed, the responsibility postings carry no claim link; re-run: REPLAY closure equals initial_state.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context]
With compute/GT masked: the extension rule says the extended due date waits on a documents-requested date and due date (both empty) -> the document-period rule; that rule's period is fixed only after the percent is reassessed -> the countable-percent rule. Working each from the visible records gives 133.1, then 62 days (due 2026-12-07), then 38 days (due 2027-01-14) — same objects, order and values as gold. The one place a careful reader could hesitate — the Social Security letter also qualifying for the smaller disregard — is settled by the ladder's words ('a case with no such statement but ...').

[Round 2 — audit items closed]
F-1 / T1-1: the documents-request computation's method factor was a constant offset (3/1/0 days). Replaced by response_count_convention, whose tiers change how the days counted so far are counted: business days from the request date for a mail application, calendar days from the next business day after the request date (Monday after a Friday) for a phone application without portal activity, calendar days from the request date otherwise. The two constant parameters were removed. On this world the tier and every figure are unchanged (59 -> 60 -> weekend move -> 62; baseline 59); the computation now has 5 parameter + 1 honest method factors.
O-3: the disregard ladder now reads 'the most recently received unemployment benefit statement', which is what the machine reads; same tier here.
O-4: the tax-return ladder now reads 'the most recently received tax return'; same tier here.
O-5: the business-day conversion adds the two weekend days only when a remainder exists and runs past a Friday (no change on a weekday due date).
O-9: the countable-percent rule no longer states the reassess-before-request order from the depended-on side; it now applies to 'a submitted application that carries no documents-requested date' (a state), and the order lives only in the document-period rule's prerequisite sentence.
O-T1-2: the claim lines behind the two insured invoices were restored (submitted / contractual / deductible on the pathology claim; submitted / PR-204 denial / transfer to patient on the esoteric claim) and linked from the responsibility postings; one read (find_claim_events) was added, shifting the write steps to 15, 17 and 19.
Re-run: EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY (20 actions, closure equals initial_state), SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE all OK; computed values unchanged.

[Round 3 — audit items closed]
R2-T1-1: the four prose step references were brought in line with the shifted call indices — the stage facts of the request (reassessed by step 15) and of the extension (request at step 17), the agency-allowance trace (percent recorded after step 15) and the time-left-credit trace (value from step 17). Every remaining 'step N' in this file was re-swept against evaluation_criteria and names a write call.
R2-O2: the phone-application counting convention now starts from the next business day for a Saturday request as well (following Monday); this world's request is a Tuesday, so the tier and figures are unchanged.
R2-F1 (charter, task 0) does not reach this world: the case is a first application (the household holds no approved award), so the countable-percent reassessment applies to it as before.
Re-run: all gates OK; computed values unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Calvin Yarborough, 53, of East Point, Georgia. You lost your job as a warehouse supervisor at the end of June, had knee surgery in late August and spent part of September in a rehabilitation facility; you are home now, still on crutches, and you speak slowly and a little apologetically. Last Monday, September 28, you applied by phone for help with your Halverson Clinical Laboratories bills, and since then you have been mailing in whatever paperwork you could find. You are calling because you already know you will not get everything in quickly: your copy of the 2025 tax return was lost and the IRS told you a transcript takes several weeks, and getting around is hard right now. Your one request is more time to get your documents in; you open with it in plain words, something like: I applied for help with my lab bills last week and I need more time to get my paperwork to you. You have not received any letter with a deadline yet; if the agent asks, you say so and that you do not know your due date. You give your details only when the agent asks: your phone number is 4045559024, your date of birth is 1972-11-03 (you say November 3, 1972, and give it as 1972-11-03 if the agent wants the digits), and your ZIP code is 30344. Only if the agent asks about your household or income do you repeat what you told the phone representative: four people (you, your wife Denise and your sons Marcus, 19, and Jalen, 16) and $44,900 a year; you have nothing to add to that. Only if the agent asks about insurance do you say that your job's health plan ended on June 30 and that you applied for Medicaid on October 1 and gave the laboratory the pending Medicaid information, with no answer yet. You do not use the patient portal; you get your mail at home and you pay bills by phone or by mail. If the agent tells you that something has to be updated or sent out on your application before more time can be given, you tell them to go ahead and you wait; you do not ask about the details and you do not argue with any figure they mention. If the agent tells you that the extra time is something you have to ask for yourself and hands that step to you, you do it right away in the same call, entering exactly the application reference number and the number of days the agent gives you; if the agent has not told you the number of days, you ask for it before you submit, and you never choose a number yourself. After you submit, you read back the new due date you see if the agent asks. You have no other request and you do not bring up any bill, fee or other matter. Once the agent confirms your new due date, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's patient profile from the phone number he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and every write needs his customer reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity check with the two details he states (phone number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Records may be discussed or changed only after identity is verified with two matching details.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his assistance case: submitted 2026-09-28 by phone at the Financial Assistance Full Discount tier, household 4, income 44,900.00, recorded percent 139.7, uninsured, no documents request and no due date yet.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the application lacks a documents request (no requested or due date), gives the income and household the countable percent works on, the application channel and date, and the tier whose Medicaid screening line the agency allowance reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the eight documents received for the case with their types and dates (an old 2024 tax return, pay stubs, unemployment statements, a Social Security letter, a zero-income attestation).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the benefit disregard, the tax-return allowance, the household-earner allowance, the file credit and the household-letter allowance.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his coverages: the employer plan that ended 2026-06-30 and the Medicaid Managed Care Plan pending verification since 2026-10-02.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the deduction window, the recognition rate (no active coverage), the agency allowance, the coverage-loss allowance and the pending-coverage allowance.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his invoices: the esoteric and routine invoices on assistance-review hold, the paid bedside invoice and the pathology invoice carried on his payment plan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the invoice context of the payments counted and shows nothing else is owed for the decision of this call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every invoice ledger line: payments with dates, methods and channels (card, health savings card, check, ACH returned), the returned payment and its fee, statements and postings.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the payments counted within the deduction window and how they were paid, and the payment channels that show the request and the extension are handled by mail and phone.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the claim lines behind the two insured invoices: the pathology claim's deductible assigned 2025-12-02 and the esoteric claim's PR-204 denial transferred to the patient on 2026-06-04, both on the employer plan that ended 2026-06-30, neither appealed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the responsibilities the counted payments paid are final payer decisions under the ended plan, with no claim pending or under appeal that could still send those payments back, so they enter the payments counted as they stand.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his orders behind the invoices and visits.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Parents of the test charges, invoices and visits read for the recognition rate and the stay allowance.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the test charges posted on his orders: eleven in the last twelve months.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the recognition rate (at least six test charges in the last twelve whole months).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his 6-Month Payment Plan: active, manual payments, balance 50.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the plan installments counted (active plan).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan ledger: enrollment and five installments of 50.00, none missed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the installments paid within the deduction window (200.00) and proves no installment was missed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read his collection visits: the facility bedside collection on 2026-09-10, the mobile in-home collection on 2026-09-21 and the missed mobile visit of 2026-07-08.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the stay allowance and shows he is not Medicare homebound.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the visit fee lines: trip and additional-patient fees paid 2026-09-21 and the no-show fee paid 2026-07-10.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the collection fees counted (trip and additional-patient fees count, the no-show fee does not).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the percent reassessment action.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the first prerequisite write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the case's countable percent 133.1 with the Financial Assistance Full Discount tier it falls in.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The documents request's response period is fixed only after the percent is reassessed on countable income; the value is uniquely produced by the countable-percent policy.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.assistance_case_id: Value 270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2. Basis: the countable-percent rule applies 'Before a documents request is issued on a submitted application'; find_assistance_cases returns one case for the customer, status submitted, applied 2026-09-28; the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the assistance case being reassessed, as returned by the assistance-case lookup'. Uniqueness: it is his only case.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fpl_percent: Value 133.1. Factors: deduction window 4 whole months (employer plan ended 2026-06-30, 3 whole months ago, plus one); payments within it 1084.00, less the 180.00 health savings card payment (the household paid with such a card) and the 100.00 returned ACH payment = 804.00; recognition rate 100 (no active coverage, 11 test charges in 12 months); plan installments counted 200.00 (active plan, none missed, 4 installments in the window); collection fees counted 110.00 (trip 75.00 + additional patient 35.00; the no-show fee excluded); deduction RND(804.00 + 200.00 + 110.00, 2) = 1114.00; job-loss disregard 1000.00 (unemployment statement dated 2026-09-28, 0 days before the application); countable income 44900.00 - 1000.00 - 1114.00 = 42786.00; guideline 15650.00 + 3 x 5500.00 = 32150.00; RND(42786.00 / 32150.00 x 100, 1) = 133.1.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.variant_name: Value 'Financial Assistance Full Discount'. Basis: the rule records the percent 'together with the income tier that percent falls in', and the tier bands (base tier determination: 'An income tier applies when fpl_percent is above fpl_min_pct and at most fpl_max_pct (the Full Discount band starts at zero income)') put 133.1 in the Full Discount band (0 to 200). Uniqueness: 25% (300-400], 50% (250-300] and 75% (200-250] bands exclude 133.1; Presumptive Eligibility rests on a program enrollment, not a percent; the hardship adjustment is not the tier this rule records.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the documents request action.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the second prerequisite write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Issue the documents request with a 62-day response period: requested today, due 2026-12-07, case pending documents.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The application lacks documents and has no request (state_due); the extended due date is not fixed until the case carries a requested date and a due date; the response days are uniquely produced by the document-period policy.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.assistance_case_id: Value 270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2. Basis: the document-period rule applies to 'An application that needs documents and lacks them'; the case is submitted with no documents-requested date; docstring: 'the reference number of the assistance case the request is issued on, as returned by the assistance-case lookup'. Uniqueness: his only case.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.response_days: Value 62. Factors: tier documents due days 30; agency allowance 15 (no active coverage and the reassessed percent 133.1 at or below the Full Discount screening line 138); tax-return allowance 10 (the most recently received tax return is for tax year 2024, ended 20 whole months before the application date); household-earner allowance 7 (household of 4 with pay stubs and benefit statements); file credit 3 (8 documents received); 59 days counted so far; counting convention for a phone application without portal activity: calendar days from the next business day after Tuesday's request date -> 60; 2026-10-06 + 60 falls on Saturday 2026-12-05, weekend move +2; total 62 (due 2026-12-07).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Hand the extension request to the applicant.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The extension is granted at the applicant's own request; the agent unlocks it and hands it over.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The applicant requests his extension of 38 days, moving the documents due date from 2026-12-07 to 2027-01-14.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: His surface request; the days are uniquely produced by the document-extension policy evaluated after the request is issued.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.assistance_case_id: Value 270f7c7f-d050-4a30-9f22-687bbb33ecc2. Basis: the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the applicant's assistance case, as given to the applicant by the agent from the assistance-case lookup'; the customer enters 'exactly the application reference number' the agent gives. Uniqueness: his only case, the one now pending documents.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.extension_days: Value 38. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (extension <- documents request <- reassessment), so the order is fixed by the two edges: the reassessment must precede the request (the request read 50 days instead of 62 on the unreassessed percent, run with the reassessment write skipped), and the request must precede the extension (without it the case has no due date to extend). No two writes are parallel.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the documents request leaves documents_due_date empty: the extension computation has no due date to count from (days_left undefined, the run raises), no documents_requested_date or pending_documents status is written, and the terminal case lacks the 2026-12-07 due date the extension moves to 2027-01-14.

Skipping the reassessment leaves fpl_percent 139.7, above the Medicaid screening line 138: the agency allowance becomes 5 instead of 15 days, counted days 50 (Wednesday 2026-11-25, no weekend move), response_days 50 instead of 62; the terminal case also keeps 139.7 instead of 133.1.
